verdict.rationale: Letta is itself an agent product, so users delegate work directly to its built-in agents. The docs describe cloud agents that sweep bug reports, open pull requests, run on their own computers while your laptop is closed, spawn subagents for complex tasks, and take scheduled prompts. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation quality (community evidence is mostly from Letta staff).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: agents running on cloud computers can access your repositories to do work — sweeping bug reports, opening pull requests, or exploring your codebase.
Subagents are specialized agents that your main agent can spawn to handle complex tasks autonomously.
Agents can still be messaged even if your laptop is closed, since they have their own computer to run on.
Agents connected to Slack are always-on: mention them in a channel or thread and they'll respond, using their cloud computer to do real work.
